Export limits on residential batteries create a direct tension between hardware capacity and realized

curtailed even on the sunniest days. The constraint is not a flaw in the battery chemistry or inverter

their incremental hardware investment deliver less than the headline payback math suggests. Tesla's
approach of pairing power wall with solar and virtual power plant programs assumes owners can
monetize stored energy through export or time of use arbitrage. In markets where export caps bind
early, that assumption weakens and the incremental value of a second or third power wall shrinks.
Owners in the affected threads are already adjusting charge and discharge schedules manually.
